title: I vibe-coded a game, added leaderboards, now my students are breaking the scores
author: meischix
selftext:
So I teach at a university, and I vibe-coded this little game about two of my favorite things: parkour and knife-fighting (I train in Filipino martial arts). I used Claude and [Unity MCP](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Unity-MCP). Mostly using Opus 5 High since usage is boosted. I also tried Sonnet 5 High, and it works fine on general coding tasks.

I added a leaderboard and gave it to my students last night. They went through it UNTIL DAWN, and this one student really broke the records on the leaderboard. Even with a bit of friendly competition of their own.

So the video is my own miserable attempt at playing my own game 😂, but my student did it in 35 seconds!

If you want to try to beat that time, [here's the link](https://meischix.itch.io/slashkill).
